title: Scenarios
intro: The stories a game is started from. A scenario is a draft until it is published.
deleteScenarioHint: Only a scenario no game was started from can be deleted, with its own definitions.
catalogueHint: The scenario's own definitions: added to the world's, or replacing the world's one of the same reference.

form.title: Title
form.synopsisHint: In English, shown to the players among the scenarios a character may play.
form.glossaryHint: Proper names of this story that are no person nor place of the game, added to the world's.
form.startingKitHint: What every character starting this scenario receives, besides what their profession gives. A unique item is given once at most: never twice by the scenario, nor by the scenario and a profession.
form.kitItemsHint: JSON list, empty for none. Each item names an item of the world or of this scenario (definition), with a line of English telling it apart (descriptor, or null), how many (quantity) and whether it is worn or wielded (equipped).
form.kitResourcesHint: JSON object, empty for none: a number for each resource of the world, by reference, added to what the profession gives.
form.flagsHint: The closed list of notable turns of the story extraction may record, written as JSON: each with its reference and one line of English telling when the narration sets it. Events read them; extraction never sets a flag that is not listed.
form.eventsHint: What happens in the story without the player, written as JSON, each once at most. when: a deadline (at: day from 1, and a period or a time of day), conditions on the state (flag, item_held_by, item_gone, npc_dead, npc_disposition, npc_at, location_visited), and a delay after they first hold. unless: conditions that cancel it as it falls due. place: the named place it happens in, or null for everywhere. description: one line of English for the model. effects: npc_moved, npc_left, npc_entered, npc_disposition, schedule_stopped, passage_blocked, passage_cleared, passage_discovered, passage_unlocked, place_note_set, place_note_cleared, item_placed, item_transferred, item_gone, flag_set, character_harmed (damage: dice such as 12D6, 6 or 2D4+8, less the armour worn — only if the character is where it happens, or it happens everywhere). interrupts: it cuts a long action short when the character sees it. foreseeable: the conditions under which the character knows it is coming and may wait for it — an empty list for always, null for never.
form.startHint: Picked from the named places of the world and the scenario, and from this scenario's chapters and quests.
form.startTimeHint: When the story opens, on its first day. The players only ever see the period of the day.
form.startDateHint: In the Gregorian calendar, if the story has one. Leave it empty for a story with no date: the game then counts its days.
form.questSummaryHint: In English, for the model: what the character has to do.
form.knownNpcsHint: The named people the character knows by name before meeting them — a relative, the person a letter is for. Anyone else is named only once they give their name.

publication.title: Publication
publication.draft: Draft: only game masters see it, to try it out.
publication.published: Published: players may start a game from it. Edits reach new turns at once.

issues.missing_english_label: A name in English is missing.
issues.invalid_dice: “{{reference}}” is no dice expression such as 1D6+1.
issues.unknown_skill: “{{reference}}” is no skill of this world.
issues.unknown_resource: “{{reference}}” is no resource of this world.
issues.unknown_location: “{{reference}}” is no named place of this world.
issues.unknown_item: “{{reference}}” is no item of this world.
issues.unknown_holder: “{{reference}}” is no named person or place of this world.
issues.unknown_npc: “{{reference}}” is no named person of this world.
issues.unknown_chapter: “{{reference}}” is no chapter of this scenario.
issues.unknown_quest: “{{reference}}” is no quest of this scenario.
issues.unknown_tag: The tag “{{reference}}” is no place, person or item of this world: the fragment would never be sent.
issues.no_action_type: The world has no category of action: no action could be rolled.
issues.missing_generic_npc: No generic person to improvise passers-by from.
issues.missing_location_archetype: No place archetype to improvise places from.
issues.missing_generic_item: No generic item to improvise objects from.
issues.no_profession: The world has no profession: no character could be created to play the story.
issues.missing_initial_state: The story has no starting place yet.
issues.not_stackable: “{{reference}}” is not stackable: one copy only.
issues.item_held_elsewhere: “{{reference}}” is unique and already held by someone else when the game starts.
issues.item_given_twice: “{{reference}}” is unique, and would be given twice as a game starts: by the scenario and a profession, or twice by the scenario.
issues.exit_to_itself: A place cannot lead to itself.
issues.duplicate_passage: Two passages join the same places: declare it once, on one side.
issues.invalid_duration: “{{reference}}” is no duration of a passage: moment, minutes, hour or hours.
issues.entrance_without_exits: “{{reference}}” is an entrance, but has no exit: it is part of no network.
issues.unreachable_network: Nothing leads into the network of “{{reference}}”: mark one of its places as an entrance, or start the story in it.
issues.start_contains_network: “{{reference}}” only contains a network: start the story in one of its places.
issues.unknown_flag: “{{reference}}” is no flag of this scenario.
issues.not_unique: “{{reference}}” is no unique definition: an event names a single person or item.
issues.unknown_passage: No passage joins these two places ({{reference}}).
issues.schedule_overlap: The period “{{reference}}” is in more than one entry of this schedule.
issues.event_without_trigger: The event “{{reference}}” has neither a deadline nor conditions: nothing sets it off.
issues.event_cycle: The event “{{reference}}” is part of a chain that sets itself off again.

importHint: A scenario as written in the game content. Its places, people, items and lore are created with it.
